state.objective: Reduce only the client's inventory-related COA families through dimensions while preserving accounting nature, valuation, ownership, cut-off and reconciliation.
confirmed_context: Centralized retail finance. HO controls finance. Units handle physical goods and cash. Direct unit-to-unit activity is not allowed; operational movement is governed centrally.
Unit suffix E1 has already been removed from natural accounts and stored as site_id.
No general counter_site_id or related_site_id will be added to journal lines.
A shipment/transfer document may carry origin_site_id and destination_site_id when operationally required; those fields need not become natural accounts or general journal dimensions.
Current working COA is 488 after the bank proposal, with asset scenarios considered separately. Do not calculate total COA counts.
No inventory policy, valuation method, posting examples, balances, item master, transfer documents or cut-off procedure has been provided.

actual_client_accounts.in_transit_28: BDP Barang Dagangan for each of 14 named HO/unit locations, and BDP Kantong Belanja for the same 14 locations.
allowance_2: Cadangan Kerusakan atau kehilangan Barang - Barang Dagangan
Cadangan Kerusakan atau kehilangan Barang - Kantong Belanja
related_unresolved: Kehilangan Barang atau Selisih Stock Opname

item_identity.instructions: Should bag material, size and individual merchandise identity normally live in item_id/item_class rather than separate natural GL accounts when a perpetual inventory subledger reconciles to GL?

criteria.dimension: Use item_id/item_class for identity; retain GL distinctions only for accounting nature or required reporting.
criteria.gl: Every item/material/size must remain a natural GL.
criteria.insufficient: The conditional architecture itself is unsupported.

goods_vs_bags.instructions: Can merchandise held for sale and shopping bags be merged into one on-hand inventory natural account solely because both are inventory-like?

criteria.review: First verify whether bags are inventory, consumable supplies, packaging expense, or separately reported stock and how they are relieved.
criteria.one: Merge immediately into one inventory GL.
criteria.always_two: They must always remain two GLs regardless of policy.

ten_bag_accounts.instructions: If all ten shopping-bag accounts share recognition, valuation and consumption policy, can plastic/paper and size detail move to item attributes beneath one shopping-bag inventory GL?

criteria.conditional_merge: Yes, subject to item-subledger reconciliation and common policy.
criteria.retain_ten: Keep ten natural GLs even under common policy.
criteria.immediate: Merge solely from similar names without evidence.

transit_nature.instructions: Must inventory in transit remain a separate natural-account nature from on-hand inventory when cut-off and control-transfer timing differ?

criteria.separate: Keep in-transit separate from on-hand until receipt/recognition event.
criteria.combine: Use the same natural GL without regard to transit state.
criteria.review: Transit never needs distinct accounting treatment.

transit_locations.instructions: Can the 14 location names within BDP Barang Dagangan be removed from natural GLs when shipment records identify the relevant location and reconcile to the transit control account?

criteria.conditional_merge: One merchandise-in-transit GL plus shipment/location detail.
criteria.retain_14: Keep one GL for every location.
criteria.immediate: Merge without confirming what the named location means.

transit_two_classes.instructions: Should BDP Barang Dagangan and BDP Kantong Belanja be merged into one transit GL from names alone?

criteria.review: Keep two provisional transit classes until ownership, valuation and expense/receipt treatment are confirmed; item class may later support one.
criteria.always_two: They can never share a transit GL.

named_location_meaning.instructions: Before mapping 28 BDP accounts, must the client confirm whether each named location is origin, destination, custodian, or merely reporting label?

criteria.yes: Meaning affects shipment mapping, cut-off and reconciliation.
criteria.no: The name can be discarded without understanding it.

counter_site.instructions: Does compressing BDP location accounts require a general counter_site_id on every journal line?

criteria.no: Use shipment/transfer document origin and destination where needed; journal keeps relevant site and shipment reference.
criteria.yes: Add counter_site_id to all journal lines.
criteria.account: Encode both sites in natural account numbers.

allowance_nature.instructions: Must damage/loss allowance remain separate from gross inventory natural accounts?

criteria.separate: Keep allowance/contra inventory as a separate accounting nature.
criteria.net: Post directly into gross inventory without separate allowance.
criteria.expense: Treat the allowance balance as expense.

two_allowances.instructions: Can the two allowance accounts become one allowance GL with inventory_class detail if methodology, measurement and reporting are the same?

disposed_inventory.instructions: Can Disposed Inventory be classified conclusively as inventory asset, contra inventory, disposal clearing, or expense from the account name alone?

criteria.no: Inspect journal entries, normal balance and counterpart accounts.

loss_expenses.instructions: Can Biaya Kerusakan Persediaan and Kehilangan Barang atau Selisih Stock Opname be merged merely because both reduce inventory value?

criteria.review: Check cause, approval workflow, allowance usage and management reporting before merging.
criteria.merge: Merge immediately into one loss GL.
criteria.retain: They must always be separate regardless of process.

migration_gate.instructions: What is the minimum safe gate before compressing the inventory accounts?

criteria.records: Item master, valuation/recognition policy, sample postings, shipment cut-off, opening mapping and subledger-to-GL reconciliation.
criteria.jev: Repeated Jev judgments without client records.
